title: The Pastel Gingerbread House Decorating Night for Kids
description: A pastel gingerbread house decorating night for kids from Sam's Club: a ready-to-decorate gingerbread house kit, the Member's Mark plush gingerbread family, Member's Mark gingerbread glass serving bowls, a ceramic Christmas tree cookie jar and a Zunie girls bow tree holiday sweatshirt.
intro: Gingerbread house night is ninety percent icing on the table and ten percent house. I've made peace with that. This setup leans into it: a ready-to-decorate kit so nobody is baking walls at 7 pm, pink glass bowls for the candy that will mostly get eaten, a tree cookie jar for the cookies that definitely will, and a plush gingerbread family to stand guard and look adorable in every picture. Add a bow tree sweatshirt for your littlest decorator and call it tradition.

sections.heading: The decorating table
paragraphs: The ready-to-decorate Gingerbread House Kit with icing and candy, the Member's Mark Holiday Icon glass serving bowls set of 2 in the gingerbread design, and the ceramic holiday cookie jar in the Christmas tree design.

sections.heading: The cozy extras
paragraphs: The Member's Mark plush gingerbread family, set of 4, with adjustable legs, and the Zunie girls holiday sweatshirt in cream with an embroidered bow tree.

sections.heading: What is real and what is styling
paragraphs: The products are the pieces linked here. The kitchen, the candy and everything else in the photos are styling extras.
